method: Anonymous urllib GET with no authorization or cookies; four workers; 20s timeout; one retry for transient HTTP/network errors; response bodies discarded.

limitations: Static publication check only; this does not test browser interactions.
Supabase OAuth and cross-device sync were deferred and are not verified here.
Release creation and release version are outside this check.
